|quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Blade Vortex''' (often referred to as '''BV''') is a [[spell]] that creates an ethereal blade that spins around the caster that deals [[physical damage]], each blade lasting for the minimum [[duration]] of 4 seconds. ==Skill functions and interactions== '''Blade Blast of Unloading''': When targeted by {{il|Blade Blast of Unloading}}, the blades will detonate in sequence, increasing in AoE with subsequent detonations. The damage from these detonations scale solely from the Blade Blast skill. '''Maximum blades''': Up to 10 blade stacks can be active at a time. Each stack has its own duration. '''Hit interval''': When the blade is first spawned, the skill will deal a hit after the hit interval duration (0.6 seconds with one blade). '''Multiple copies:''' You can only have one Blade Vortex effect at any one time. Casting Blade Vortex with another copy of the gem will remove all active stacks and start a new Blade Vortex effect. '''Multiple casts:''' Using Blade Vortex while you have no Blade Vortex effect will create a new Blade Vortex effect with all the "spell cast" modifiers baked into that Blade Vortex effect. Any subsequent uses of Blade Vortex will only add a stack to the currently active effect. This means that the less damage from {{il|Unleash Support}} or more damage from [[Greater Spell Echo Support]] are normally not applied, since the casts which have those damage modifiers are typically ones which are only adding another stack. However, removing the active Blade Vortex effect during the cast time will allow you to [[snapshot]] the effects of a later cast in a series of repeats (e.g. use {{il|Blade Blast of Unloading}} and {{il|Blastchain Mine Support}}). This allows you to [[snapshot]] the more damage and increased AoE from [[Greater Spell Echo Support]] for as long as that Blade Vortex effect lasts. However, at least from Dec 2022, there is a bug when using this strategy with {{il|Plume of Pursuit}}. Instead of causing the whole Blade Vortex effect to either always critically strike or never critically strike, it will merely allow the Blade Vortex effect to critically strike as if {{il|Plume of Pursuit}} were not equipped. Note also that [[Intensity]] updates on each cast, and stats that apply per [[hit]] instead of per cast do not [[snapshot]]. '''Visual effect:''' Blade vortex's visual effect does not scale with [[Area of effect]] modifiers. Instead, to give a rough indication of radius, there are several versions of the knife effect, each rotating at a different radius. The skill will always try to have one knife using the largest-radius effect that's not larger than the actual radius of the skill, but that skill results in discrete visual changes where you need to reach a certain threshold before the next wider effect can be used. The full radius is always used mechanically. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Physical
Damage |c1_header = Deals x to y Physical Damage |c1_pattern_extract = Deals (%d+) to (%d+) Physical Damage |c1_pattern_value = %d to %d |c2_abbr = Radius |c2_header = +x metres to radius |c2_pattern_extract = %+(%d+%.*%d*) metres? to radius |c2_pattern_value = +%sm }} ==Calculating DPS== Blade Vortex's in-game tooltip DPS gives the average damage of one hit from one Blade Vortex instance, multiplied by casts per second. This value is misleading primarily because Blade Vortex can hit more than once over its duration, thus cast speed must not be used, but hits per second (rounds per second, spin rate), over the duration of the stacks. ==Math and tables== Base spin rate of Blade Vortex is 600 ms. Blade Vortex hit more frequently with more stacks it has. As gem says: 35% increased Hit Rate for each blade. So spin time is calculated as {{math |formula = Spin Time = {Base Spin Time \over (1 + Spin Time Reduction \times Stacks Count) } }} {{math |formula = Rounds Per Second = {1 \over Spin Time} = { ( 1 + Spin Time Reduction \times Stacks Count) \over Base Spin Time} }} Assuming spin rate increases for 35% for each stack, we have the following data: {| class="wikitable" ! Stacks !! Hit Rate (ms) !! Hits Per Second |- |0||600||1.667 |- |1||444||2.250 |- |2||353||2.833 |- |3||293||3.417 |- |4||250||4.000 |- |5||218||4.583 |- |6||194||5.167 |- |7||174||5.750 |- |8||158||6.333 |- |9||145||6.917 |- |10||133||7.500 |} Each stack of Blade Vortex increases hit damage with the following formula: {{math |formula = Hit Damage = {Base Hit Damage \times { (1 + F \times Stacks Count ) } } }} Where {{math |display=inline |formula=F }} is per-stack damage increase factor. Then we need just multiply hits per second with hit damage. {{math |formula = Damage Per Second Multiplier = {Hit Damage \times Rounds Per Second } }} Assuming 35% more damage per stack, then using base hit damage as 1, we would expect the following per-hit damage increases: {| class="wikitable" ! Stacks !! Damage Per Hit !! Effective DPS Multiplier |- |0||1.00||1.667 |- |1||1.35||3.04 |- |2||1.70||4.82 |- |3||2.05||7.00 |- |4||2.40||9.60 |- |5||2.75||12.60 |- |6||3.10||16.02 |- |7||3.45||19.84 |- |8||3.80||24.07 |- |9||4.15||28.70 |- |10||4.50||33.75 |} Finally, to obtain sustained DPS from tooltip use the following formula: {{math |formula = Sustained DPS = { { Damage Per Second Multiplier \times Tooltip DPS } \over Casts Per Second} }} or in expanded form {{math |formula = Sustained DPS = { { { ( 1 + {Per Stack Damage Increase Factor \times Stacks Count} ) \times ( 1 + {Spin Time Reduction \times Stacks Count} ) } \times Tooltip DPS} \over ( {Casts Per Second \times Base Spin Time} ) } }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} {{Alternate skill effect list}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.29.0| * Blade Vortex: Now has 30% increased Hit Rate for each blade (previously 35%), and 30% more Damage for each blade (previously 35%).
